project_name: Treesh Music Web App - Rich Song Page

theme_support.dark_theme: Default - Dark Cosmic Purple Glass (#0b0518 base with glassmorphism)
theme_support.light_theme: Toggled via html.theme-light class - Soft Warm Lilac / Off-white Glass

fonts.numerical_stats: Doto (via class font-doto for playback stats and counts)

layout_architecture.desktop: 1440x900 - Bento Grid 12 cols within main view container, sticky mini-header on scroll
layout_architecture.mobile: 390x844 - Single column fluid stacked layout with sticky top bar and floating bottom nav offset
layout_architecture.hero_section: Hero card with blurred cover background tint, 320x320 cover (desktop) / 260x260 (mobile), vinyl glow, pill stats, action control buttons
section_order: sgp-hero-card (cover, badges, titles, artist, main action controls)
sgp-lyrics-card (6-8 lines lyrics preview + section badges + open lyrics CTA)
sgp-facts-grid (Song facts & computed analytics: word count, lines, per-artist verse bar, audio specs)
sgp-stats-card (User play stats: play count in font-doto, rank, relative last played, favorited lyrics)
sgp-credits-card (Album, release date, label, genre, mood chips, written by, producer, mixer, video button)
sgp-related-section (Horizontal carousel: More from artist & Similar songs)

image_urls.description: Vinyl album art fallback and default song hero background tint
Featured artist and song visual concept art

instructions_to_main_agent: Render the Song Page when navigating to #/song/<id> or clicking song title/cover art in any row.
Do NOT navigate to song page when tapping the play icon button on a row; play button must only start playback.
Use sgp- prefix for all Song Page specific CSS utility classes in p9_css / app stylesheet.
Ensure complete responsive layout compatibility for 390x844 (mobile) and 1440x900 (desktop).
Support html.theme-light by using CSS variables and color-mix instead of hardcoded white/black text.
All interactive elements must include their defined data-testid attributes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Never apply universal transition: all. Always specify transition properties explicitly.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭 for icons. Use Lucide icons.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
